subject.title: Add Atomic Chat as a bundled local provider (OpenAI-compatible, 127.0.0.1:1337)

question: Should Atomic Chat be promoted into OpenClaw's bundled provider surface, or should OpenClaw keep it on the custom-provider/docs or external provider-plugin path?
rationale: Current OpenClaw seams already support OpenAI-compatible local servers, while bundled provider promotion adds default provider, auth, onboarding, docs, package, and maintenance surface that repository policy leaves to maintainer product judgment.

options.title: Keep Custom/Docs Path
options.body: Use the existing custom-provider route and the docs-only PR unless maintainers decide Atomic Chat has enough demand and ownership for bundled promotion.

options.title: Promote Bundled Provider
options.body: Accept the product cost of a new bundled provider and review the linked implementation PR for compatibility, auth, dependency, docs, and proof blockers.

recommendation.title: Keep Custom/Docs Path
recommendation.body: Use the existing custom-provider route and the docs-only PR unless maintainers decide Atomic Chat has enough demand and ownership for bundled promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: Provider plugin architecture and core-vs-plugin scope are the central decision surfaces for this request.
